title: IMUMIA2026: Multi-paradigm motor-imagery EEG dataset (IMU-MI_A)
description: A multi-paradigm motor-imagery EEG dataset (IMU-MI_A) recorded from healthy participants with a 64-channel Neuroscan system at 1000 Hz. Five body-part imagery tasks (hand, foot, thumb, index finger, and index-thumb pinch) were performed on the left and right sides under a Classic Arrow paradigm and a Cue-Execution dual-stage paradigm. This public sample contains five subjects from a larger 244-participant dataset and is re-released in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps amplifier and a 64-channel Quik-Cap (Ag/AgCl passive electrodes, Cz reference, forehead ground, impedance below 10 kOhm) at 1000 Hz, with auxiliary EOG, ECG and EMG channels. Each participant completed a single session of five runs, one motor-imagery task per run, with visual arrow cues and 4 s imagery periods.
